issues.detail: Threads TH2 (12 msgs), TH3 (12 msgs), TH4 (12 msgs), and TH5 (13 msgs) are all below the minimum required messages per thread of 15.
In messages M16, M40, M52, and M65, decision IDs (e.g., 'D1', 'D2') are incorrectly placed in the 'artifact_refs' list instead of the 'decision_refs' list.
